parts.provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored`, at a LQFP-48 7 × 7 mm (JEDEC MS-026 proportions); the gull-wing generator gives every dimension. The moulding follows Microchip's 8-lead SOIC drawing C04-057 (mould draft 5–15° top and bottom, optional pin-1 chamfer h 0.25–0.50 mm) and Fairchild/onsemi's SOIC drawings (pin-1 bevel edge as option A); bends, rounds and dimple size are estimated. Looked at, never copied: the manufacturers' photographs and package drawings cited; no vendor drawing, CAD model or EDA library data copied.
